player_prompt.intro:
I nih hi Player {player_id} ih. Memory Game ih khel ṭha. 
Ih goal chu board ah card pair ṭhenkhat te inṭin nasa zawk ih ni. 
Ih turn ah, card pahnih select ula, an awmna row leh column number te pe ṭha, '[0 1 1 0]' ang deuh, card ṭha ber chu row 0 leh column 1 ah awm a, card ṭha bera chu row 1 leh column 0 ah awm a ni. 
Card pahnih te inṭin a nih chuan, point ih hmu a, card te chu awn face up a la awm ang. Inṭin lo a nih chuan, card te chu awn face down a la awm ang, e.g. '.'. 
Game chu pair ṭhenkhat te inṭin vek a ni tih ah a tawp.

invalid_move.wrong_format: A khelhna format diklo. Player {player_id} chuan a khelh dan tur chu bracket-a ziak ang hian a chhâng lo va, player pakhatin an hmalakna hi a sawi fel thei ta lova.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Hlawk diklo. Player {player_id} chuan out-of-bounds position a thlang ta a ni.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Hlawk diklo. Player {player_id} chuan card inang hi vawi hnih a thlang ve leh ta a ni.
invalid_move.already_matched: Hlawk diklo. Player {player_id} chuan a khelh tawh card pakhat emaw, pahnih emawin a thlang ta mai a ni.

game_message.cards_match: The cards selected by Player {player_id} at positions [{r1} {c1}] and [{r2} {c2}] match!
game_message.cards_no_match: The cards selected by Player {player_id} do not match. Cards at positions [{r1} {c1}] and [{r2} {c2}] are {pos1} and {pos2} respectively.

outcome.draw: Player pahnihte chuan card pair khat an siam ṭheuh a.
outcome.turn_limit: Turn limit a thleng ta. Game a tawp ta. Player 0 hian {score_0} point a hmu, Player 1 hian {score_1} point a hmu.
